title: FAQ: Common Error Codes
summary: This document is a troubleshooting reference for “Common Error Codes,” listing bank/transfer/auth errors (101, 202, 403, 409, 429, 903) with specific suggested resolutions, plus debit card decline codes 05, 14, 54, and 56 including status/field checks (e.g., fraud_alert_active, velocity_blocked, expiration_date) and the “48 hours” wait for error 903. It also includes escalation steps and the 1-800-RHO-ACCT guidance for restricted accounts, and a “30 minutes” auto-lift for velocity blocks.
faqs: What should I do if I see Error 101 (Invalid account or routing details)?
How do I resolve Error 202 (Insufficient funds) and what retry steps are suggested?
What actions are recommended for Error 403 (Authentication failed), including password reset and security holds?
Why do I get Error 903 (Account closure request blocked) and how long should I wait before trying again?
What does debit card decline Code 05 mean, and how do I handle card status (FROZEN/CLOSED/PENDING/ACTIVE), fraud alerts, velocity blocks, and restricted accounts?
What should I do for debit card decline Codes 14, 54, and 56 (invalid card number, expired card, or no card record)?
